content.description: Flowchart for diagnosing no lock-up condition after warm-up. Starts with reading diagnostic code, then road test for lock-up voltage range, then ECT ECU brake signal voltage check, ending with faulty brake signal diagnosis.
labels: Road test - Connect a voltmeter to DG terminal and body ground. Is there 7, 5 or 3V in the lock-up range while driving?
Is voltage between ECT ECU BR and GND terminal as follows? Brake pedal depressed: 12V Brake pedal released: 0V
Faulty computer power source and earth.

content.text:
Warm up engine
Coolant temp: 80°C (176°F)
ATF temp: 50 — 80°C (122 — 176°F)

Road test
Connect a voltmeter to DG terminal and body ground. Is there 7, 5 or 3V in the lock-up range while driving?

Is voltage between ECT ECU BR and GND terminal as follows?
Brake pedal depressed: 12V
Brake pedal released: 0V

items: Faulty computer power source and earth.
